messages:
olivia: thinking about tightening up our gateway fallback chain for capacity-constrained Dedicated pools. idea: prefer header-driven safelist -> tenant priority -> local quantized variant -> backup-model in-region -> hosted cheap fallback. important: `X-Route-Override` should be allowed from infra or tenant-devs for canaries, but admin emergency flags must always override it. any concerns?
sam: couple questions: 1) how do we avoid header affinity causing a hot shard if a few clients start setting prefer-local? 2) billing/quotas: when a request is routed to backup-model, do we count it against the tenant's reserved capacity or bill as hosted? we need a clear billing_note tag.
kai: route precedence idea: exact path + header overrides > tenant policy > global policy. implement a per-tenant throttle when header indicates `prefer-local` to avoid shard hotspots (token cap per-minute). for circuit breaker fallbacks, emit tag `fallback.reason=cb` and `fallback.path=backup-model-vX` so metrics can roll up. add a soft-ttl (`fallback.cooldown`) to avoid oscillation when capacity fluctuates.
maria: from console/rollouts POV we need a rollout card that shows: fallback_rate (sparkline), cb_trigger_rate, p99 latency by lane, and avg_tokens_saved. also add a "simulate header override" control so SEs can test safelist behavior without real traffic.
cheng: CB tuning suggestion: open CB when 5xx_rate > 2% AND p95_latency > 2s for a 1m sliding window AND queue_len > 10. recovery: exponential backoff with jitter, starting at 30s. apply CB per-model-per-lane, not global.
olivia: rough gateway policy sketch:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {
      path: "/api/v1/generate",
      method: "POST",
      headers: ["X-Tenant-ID"]
    }
    precedence: ["exact_path", "header_override", "tenant_policy", "global"]
    header_overrides:
      - name: "X-Route-Override"
        allow_from: ["tenant-devs", "infra"]
        block_by: ["admin-emergency"]
    fallback_chain:
      - name: "local-quantized"
        weight: 1.0
        billing_note: "reserved"
      - name: "backup-model-v2"
        weight: 0.8
        region: "same"
        billing_note: "tiered:backup"
      - name: "hosted-cheap"
        weight: 0.5
        billing_note: "hosted"
    circuit_breaker:
      enabled: true
      rules:
        - name: "latency_5xx_combined"
          trigger: "5xx_rate>0.02 && p95>2s && queue_len>10"
          open_for: "exponential_backoff"
    telemetry_tags: ["fallback.reason","fallback.path","tenant.id"]
```
sam: small nit: call it `fallback.cooldown` instead of ttl in policy; also ensure we attach `billing.sku:backup-model` to events so billing can reconcile.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: dedicated-pool-3 scaled down 2 -> 1 GPUs at 2145123465 :rotating_light: 
olivia: ok plan: i'll open a PR with the policy and a console card prototype. propose canary: 5% traffic for 24h, watch `cb_trigger_rate` and `fallback_rate` and manual rollback gate. @maria can you add the simulate button? @cheng can you land the CB thresholds?
maria: yep i'll add simulate toggle and a "force override" modal in the card. default off.
kai: also add metric `fallback.latency_delta` (backup.latency - primary.latency) and an alert if median delta > 300ms for 10m. small guard to protect quality.
olivia: thanks team — i'll tag owners in the PR and put the canary schedule on the calendar.
